experiment_data.hypothesis: Pretrained N-scaling: FewNERD N=32 with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (unfinetuned). FewNERD pretrained showed +3.90pp MV gain at N=8. Tests whether pretrained MV advantage scales with N and whether the pretrained-vs-finetuned direction flip persists at 4× budget. Complements CoNLL/SciERC pretrained N=32 for cross-dataset generalization evidence.
